description: A React component implementing a modal dialog for creating and editing Row Level Security (RLS) rules in Apache Superset. It includes form fields for rule name, filter type, datasets, roles, group key, clause, and description, with data fetching and saving logic.

classes.name: RowLevelSecurityModal
classes.description: React functional component for managing RLS rules via a modal dialog.

methods.name: updateRuleState
methods.description: Updates the current RLS rule state with a given field name and value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current rule to enable or disable the save button.

methods.name: getSelectedData
methods.description: Retrieves selected tables and roles from fetched resource data.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Clears errors and resets the form, then calls onHide.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current rule by creating or updating via API, then shows success toast.

methods.name: loadTableOptions
methods.description: Loads table options asynchronously with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: loadRoleOptions
methods.description: Loads role options asynchronously with filtering and pagination.
